encode_image_to_tokens: encode a batch of video frames into image tokens using the VCLM_HF vision encoder and attention pooling
generate_text_from_image: generate caption text from image tokens using sample-based decoding with top-k and top-p warping
beam_search_generate: generate caption text from image tokens using beam search decoding with configurable beam width and length penalty
group_beam_search_generate: generate diverse caption text from image tokens using group beam search with multiple beam groups
forward_pass_training: run a forward pass through VCLM_HF to compute text token logits and labels for training
